scientific_question: If the one-percent KFAC basis is allowed to adapt optimistically to the terminal dense model, is separable activation-gradient geometry stable and sufficient for held-out V and attention-cproj path and Muon recovery?
causal_parent: The step-zero KFAC atlas was unstable across calibration splits and worse than BlockFHT on every aggregate metric. This oracle changes only basis time: step zero to terminal dense state.

teacher_information.interpretation: This is an optimistic necessary-condition upper bound. A pass permits only an online adaptive-sketch implementation gate; it is not a trainable result.

frozen_protocol.basis_source: two disjoint CE KFAC acquisitions at the terminal dense checkpoint

decision_rule.pass: Authorize only implementation and offline validation of a causal periodically refreshed structured KFAC sketch at 124M.
decision_rule.fail: Reject one-percent separable KFAC as the attention chart even with terminal adaptation. Move to the V/O functional quotient or a nonseparable paired two-sided chart; do not run a KFAC training sweep.
